verdict.rationale: Viam exposes public APIs, SDKs and a CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The versioning it does mention covers ML models, inline modules and OTA canary rollbacks, which are adjacent features. Hardware-swap code portability is also not an API stability guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
